claims.text: Google Cloud describes the ML Engineer as someone who builds, evaluates, productionizes and optimizes AI solutions, collaborates with other roles, and trains, deploys, monitors and improves models; the exam covers serving and scaling models and monitoring AI solutions.

beats.broll: meeting room whiteboard, engineer explaining a chart

claims.text: TDRI: the skills employers most often request in Thai AI job postings are communication and English, "ระบุไว้เกิน 3 ใน 4 ของตำแหน่งงานทั้งหมด" (listed in more than 3 of 4 positions). TDRI adds that English is a requirement because research papers, API/SDK, cloud and library docs are almost all in English. The article does not state the exact period or whether the 3-in-4 applies to each skill separately; the article compares Q2 2024 with Q2 2025.
